x: Bolan Pass is a valley and a natural gateway through the Toba Kakar range in Balochistan province of Pakistan. It is situated 120 km south of Pakistan's border with Afghanistan. The pass is an 89 km stretch of the Bolan River valley from Rindli in the south to Darwāza near Kolpur in the north.

Khuzdar also known as Hozdar, is a city and the administrative headquarters of Khuzdar District in Balochistan province of Pakistan. Khuzdar is surrounded by the mountainous region of the southwestern portion of the country near central Balochistan. In terms of population, it is the 3rd-largest city in the province and 49th-largest in the country.

Kalāt or Qalāt, historically known as Qīqān or Kaikan, is a city in the Pakistani province of Balochistan. It was the historical capital of the Khanate of Kalat from the 17th to the mid-20th centuries. Situated within the Central Brahui Range, today the town is the headquarters of the Kalat District and the Kalat Division.

d: River in Balochistan and Sindh, Pakistan
x: The Hub River, also spelled Hab, is located in the Hub District of Balochistan, Pakistan. It originates in the Kirthar Mountains, drains a catchment area of about 34 square miles and flows into the Arabian Sea just west of Karachi, the capital of Pakistan.

Kalat Kali Mandir is situated in the Shahi Bazaar in the Kalat in the Balochistan province of Pakistan and is dedicated to Goddess Kali. It is one of the oldest Hindu temples in Pakistan, and hosts the second biggest Kali statue in Asia. The temple is visited by Hindus from all over Pakistan and also from India.

Sohr Damb, c. 3800–2300 BC, is an archaeological site near Nal in central Balochistan, Pakistan that begins before the Indus Valley Civilization featuring Togau, Kili Ghul Mohammad, and Kechi Beg pottery styles.
Shashan or Koh-e-Shashan is one of the highest mountains of Balochistan located in Gresha, Khuzdar District.

Khuzdar Airport is situated 5 km away from the city centre of Khuzdar, Balochistan, Pakistan. Currently, the airport operates without any scheduled flights, resulting in financial losses due to its operational costs.
Kushi is a mountain located in Pakistan, and part of the Toba Kakar Range.
Kush is a mountain near Kalat, Pakistan. It is located not far from the similarly named Kushi mountain.

Gandavah is a town that serves as the headquarters of Jhal Magsi District in the Pakistani province of Balochistan. Located on a small hill in the middle of the Kach Gandava plains, Gandava is inhabited by an ethnically mix population of Sindhi, Baloch, Pathan, Brahui, and Hindu communities.

d: Highest peak of the Kirthar Mountains of Pakistan
x: Zardak Peak is the highest peak of the Kirthar Mountains, which are a far-southern extension of the Hindukush range. It is the most prominent mountain in Balochistan and is 7,438 feet high. It is bordered to the east by the Indus plains, and to the west by the Iranian plateau.
Bhaur is a mountain range located in the Kalat District of Balochistan, Pakistan.
Nagau is a mountain range located in the Kalat District of Balochistan, Pakistan.

Moola Chotok is a hidden ravine located in the middle of the Khuzdar District in the southern province of Balochistan, Pakistan. It is situated approximately 105 kilometres north-east of Khuzdar at an elevation of 1,237 metres. Surrounded by tall cliffs, the cascading waterfall, known as Chotok, is one of the biggest waterfalls of Moola Tehsil.

Battle of Jandari also known as Battle of Kachhi was fought between the Khanate of Kalat and Kalhora Dyansty led by Mian Noor Mohammad Kalhoro due to the territorial dispute over the Kachhi region in present-day Balochistan.
Sukleji River is a river in Balochistan Province, in southwestern Pakistan.
